heading: Merchandise
intro: A small collection in the works: a few well-made things that support the everyday side of looking after yourself.
body:
We're planning a small range of things you'd actually use, made properly and with the same care as the rest of our work.

Nothing is on sale yet. The pieces below are in development, so if there's something you'd buy that isn't here, tell us. We're still deciding what to make.

products.name: Reflective Journal
products.description: A guided journal built around the questions that come up most often in therapy, with plenty of room for your own thoughts.

products.name: Grounding Card Deck
products.description: A pocket-sized set of grounding and regulation exercises to reach for when it's hard to think straight.

products.name: Organic Cotton Tote
products.description: A plain, sturdy tote with a small logo.

products.name: Ceramic Mug
products.description: A mug for the cup of tea at the end of your working day.

ctaHeading: Want to Know When It Launches?
ctaText: Send us a message and we'll let you know when the range is available. Tell us what you'd like to see in it, too.
